instructions.name: add_async_deployment_target
docs: Adds an async deployment target for the given strategy type.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `strategy_type` - The async strategy type to add the deployment target for.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: add_deployment_target
docs: Add a deployment target for the given strategy type.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `strategy_type` - The strategy type to add the deployment target for.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: add_instant_withdrawal_lender
docs: Adds a new instant withdrawal lender to the pool.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `lender` - The address of the instant withdrawal lender.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: add_mode
docs: Adds a mode to the pool.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `mode_id` - The mode ID.
* `mode_name` - The mode name.
* `target_apy_bps` - The target annual percentage yield (APY) for the underlying assets
deposited, expressed in basis points.
* `token_metadata_args` - The mode token metadata parameters.
# Dev Notes
See the docs for `ModeConfig` on how `target_apy_bps` is related to the actual APY used
for calculation.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

accounts.name: token_metadata
docs: The token metadata account.

accounts.name: mpl_token_metadata_program
docs: The MPL Token Metadata program.

instructions.name: add_pool_operator
docs: Adds a new operator to the pool.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `operator` - The address of the pool operator.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: add_redemption_request_v2
docs: Adds a new redemption request. `payer` will pay for the account rent-exempt fees.
# Arguments
* `shares` - The number of shares the lender wants to redeem.
# Trigger Condition
Only when both the protocol and the pool are on.
# Access Control
Only lenders can call this instruction.

instructions.name: add_strategy_manager_wallet
docs: Adds a new wallet for the strategy manager to the pool.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
# Arguments
* `wallet` - The wallet address.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: approve_manual_strategy_manager
docs: Approves a pending manual strategy manager proposal.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
# Access Control
Only the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: cancel_manual_strategy_manager_proposal
docs: Cancels a pending manual strategy manager proposal.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: cancel_redemption_request
docs: Reduces the number of shares request for redemption.
# Arguments
* `shares` - The number of shares in the redemption request to be canceled.
# Trigger Condition
Only when both the protocol and the pool are on.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Sentinel service account can call this instruction.

instructions.name: change_pool_owner
docs: Changes the pool owner.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `new_owner` - The new pool owner.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: clear_instant_withdrawal_liquidity_source
docs: Clears the deployment target from which liquidity is pulled when the pool's available
balance is insufficient to satisfy an instant withdrawal.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

instructions.name: close_lender_accounts
docs: Closes the accounts owned by the lender.
# Trigger Condition
N/A. The instruction can be triggered at any time.
# Access Control
Only lenders can call this instruction.

instructions.name: close_pool
docs: Closes the pool after its maturity.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the pool is in the pre-closure status.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: complete_liquidity_payback_async
docs: Completes a previously initiated payback via an async strategy. Claims the
redeemed underlying tokens from the target and updates pool accounting.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `strategy_type` - The async deployment strategy type.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: deserialize.

instructions.name: create_lender_accounts_v2
docs: Creates the accounts necessary for a lender. `payer` will pay for the account rent-exempt fees.
# Trigger Condition
1. For the pool owner treasury: when the pool is not closed.
2. For other lenders: when both the protocol and pool are on.
# Access Control
Anyone can call this instruction.

instructions.name: create_pool
docs: Creates a new permissionless pool.
# Arguments
* `pool_id` - The ID of the pool.
* `pool_name` - The name of the pool.
* `pool_owner_treasury` - The address of the pool owner treasury, which will be responsible
for providing initial liquidity and receiving pool owner fees.
# Trigger Condition
N/A. The instruction can be triggered at any time.
# Access Control
Anyone can call this instruction. The signer will become the owner of the pool.

instructions.name: declare_loss
docs: Declares loss on an investment. When the loss is on liquid assets, the strategy manager must
also update `liquid_assets_deployed` accordingly.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status.
# Dev Notes
It is possible for the strategy manager to deploy and pay back liquidity after loss declaration.
# Access Control
Only the loss authority can call this instruction.

instructions.name: deploy_liquidity
docs: Deploys liquidity from the pool to investment opportunities.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status. Deployment
is allowed in pre-closure in case the strategy manager accidentally pays more liquidity back
than required for withdrawal and needs to take the funds back.
# Arguments
* `amount` - The amount to deploy.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: deserialize. Mutable only because Jupiter Lending incorrectly requires the signer account
to be writable.

instructions.name: deploy_liquidity_async
docs: Deploys liquidity from the pool via an async strategy.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is on or in pre-closure.
# Arguments
* `strategy_type` - The async deployment strategy type.
* `amount` - The amount to deploy.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: deserialize.

instructions.name: deploy_liquidity_manually
docs: Deploys liquidity from the pool via the manual strategy. Only manual strategy managers
can call this instruction. Subject to per-transaction and daily deployment limits.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status.
# Arguments
* `amount` - The amount to deploy.
# Access Control
Only manual strategy managers can call this instruction.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: LP deposits to the pool to earn yield and share losses.
All deposits should be made by calling this instruction and
`make_initial_deposit()` (for the pool owner's initial deposit) only.
Please do NOT directly transfer any crypto assets to the pool,
which will cause a permanent loss, and we cannot help reverse transactions
or retrieve assets.
# Arguments
* `assets` - The amount of underlying assets to be deposited.
* `commitment` - The commitment type of the deposit. This is needed by other systems in the
Huma protocol to track the commitment status of the deposit.
* `commitment_auto_renewal` - Whether the commitment automatically renews after expiration.
This is needed by other systems in the Huma protocol to track the commitment status of
the deposit.
# Returns
The number of mode token minted.
# Trigger Condition
Only when both the protocol and the pool are on.
# Access Control
Anyone can call this instruction. The caller will become a lender in the pool.
# Dev Notes
1. `commitment` and `commitment_auto_renewal` are not used by the program.
They are pass-through arguments used by other systems in the Huma protocol to detect
deposit commitment violations.
2. The parameter `commitment` has type `String` instead of `enum` so that we don't have to
upgrade the program when we add additional commitment types/alter existing ones.

instructions.name: disable_pool
docs: Disables the pool. Once a pool is disabled, no money moves in or out.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the pool is on.
# Access Control
Only pool operators can call this instruction.

instructions.name: disburse
docs: Transfers all the amount that has been redeemed but not yet disbursed to the lender.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status.
# Access Control
Only lenders can call this instruction.

instructions.name: enable_pool
docs: Turns on the pool. Before a pool is turned on, the required mode liquidity must be
deposited first.
# Trigger Condition
N/A. The instruction can be triggered at any time.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: enter_pre_closure
docs: Puts the pool in pre-closure status so that final processing can happen to prepare
for closure. Pool assets will be refreshed one last time and lenders will no longer accrue
yields after the pool enters the pre-closure status.
# Trigger Condition
N/A. The instruction can be triggered at any time.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: initiate_liquidity_payback_async
docs: Initiates a liquidity payback via an async strategy. The redeemed funds may not be
available immediately and must be claimed in a separate step via
`complete_liquidity_payback_async`.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `strategy_type` - The async deployment strategy type.
* `shares` - The number of shares to redeem.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: deserialize.

instructions.name: instant_withdraw
docs: Allows a lender to withdraw their own shares directly, bypassing the redemption queue.
This provides immediate liquidity when the pool has sufficient available balance.
# Arguments
* `shares` - The number of shares the lender wants to withdraw.
* `max_fee` - The maximum fee in token base units the lender is willing to
accept. The fee is computed progressively across the liquid-asset-ratio brackets
the withdrawal traverses; if the resulting total exceeds `max_fee`, the instruction
fails with `InstantWithdrawalFeeTooHigh`.
# Trigger Condition
Only when both the protocol and the pool are on.
# Access Control
Any lender can call this instruction for their own shares.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: deserialize. Mutable only because Jupiter Lending incorrectly requires the signer account
to be writable.

instructions.name: instant_withdraw_privileged
docs: Allows an authorized instant withdrawal lender to withdraw their own shares directly,
bypassing the redemption queue. This provides immediate liquidity when the pool
has sufficient available balance.
Compared to `instant_withdraw`, this privileged path gives authorized lenders several benefits:
1. No fees are incurred.
2. The instant withdrawal reserve can be tapped into.
3. Redemption gating does not apply.
# Arguments
* `shares` - The number of shares the lender wants to withdraw.
# Trigger Condition
Only when both the protocol and the pool are on.
# Access Control
Only authorized instant withdrawal lenders can call this instruction for their own shares.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: deserialize. Mutable only because Jupiter Lending incorrectly requires the signer account
to be writable.

instructions.name: make_initial_deposit
docs: Allows the pool owner to make initial deposit before the pool goes live.
# Arguments
* `assets` - The amount of underlying assets to be deposited.
* `commitment` - The commitment type of the deposit.
# Returns
The number of mode token minted.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed.
# Access Control
Only authorized initial depositors can call this instruction.
# Dev Notes
The parameter `commitment` has type `String` instead of `enum` so that we can avoid program
upgrade when we add additional commitment types in the future.

instructions.name: pay_back_liquidity
docs: Pays back liquidity to the pool.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `amount` - The amount to pay back.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: deserialize. Mutable only because Jupiter Lending incorrectly requires the signer account
to be writable.

instructions.name: pay_back_liquidity_manually
docs: Pays back liquidity to the pool via the manual strategy.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `amount` - The amount to pay back.
# Access Control
Only manual strategy managers can call this instruction.

instructions.name: process_redemption_request
docs: Processes the redemption request at the beginning of the redemption queue.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Sentinel service account can call this instruction.

accounts.name: lender
docs: `has_one` constraint.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The recipient of the `RedemptionRequest` account rent-exempt fee refunds after closure.
`has_one` constraint.

accounts.name: strategy_manager_wallet
docs: Strategy managers wallets are allowed to process redemption requests. If the signer
is a strategy manager wallet this account needs to be passed in for validation. Otherwise,
the account can be left as `None`.

accounts.name: lender_underlying_token
docs: The account is optional to prevent an attack where a lender closes their underlying token
account and consequently blocks the redemption request from being processed.

instructions.name: propose_manual_strategy_manager
docs: Proposes a new manual strategy manager for the pool.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
# Arguments
* `wallet` - The proposed wallet address.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction. The proposal must be approved
by the Huma owner via `approve_manual_strategy_manager`.

instructions.name: recover_loss
docs: Recovers declared losses by transferring assets from the loss authority to the pool.
The transferred amount is applied to mode losses proportionally. When the recovery applies to
losses on liquid assets, the strategy manager must also update `liquid_assets_deployed` accordingly.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `amount` - The amount to transfer from the loss authority to the pool for loss recovery.
# Access Control
Only the loss authority can call this instruction.

instructions.name: refresh_mode_assets
docs: Refreshes the assets in a single mode to bring it up to date.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed. When the pool is in pre-closure,
this instruction is a no-op.
# Access Control
Anyone can call this instruction.

instructions.name: refresh_pool_assets
docs: Refreshes the assets in all modes to bring them up to date.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed. When the pool is in pre-closure,
this instruction is a no-op.
# Access Control
Anyone can call this instruction.

instructions.name: remove_async_deployment_target
docs: Removes an async deployment target.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: remove_deployment_target
docs: Removes a deployment target for the given strategy type.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: remove_instant_withdrawal_lender
docs: Removes an instant withdrawal lender from the pool.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `lender` - The address of the instant withdrawal lender.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: remove_manual_strategy_manager
docs: Removes a manual strategy manager from the pool.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: remove_mode
docs: Removes a mode from the pool. Please note that this instruction applies solely to the
reversal of unintentional mode additions. Consequently, the following conditions must
be met for the removal to go through:
1. No mode token has been minted.
2. The mode state must be empty.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `mode_id` - The ID of the mode to remove.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: remove_pool_operator
docs: Adds an operator from the pool.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `operator` - The address of the pool operator.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: remove_strategy_manager_wallet
docs: Removes a wallet for the strategy manager from the pool.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: set_huma_config
docs: Points the pool at a different `HumaConfig` account. Used only in the rare event
that the Huma protocol is redeployed with a new `HumaConfig`.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Access Control
Only the current Huma owner can call this instruction. Pool owner cannot, since
swapping the `HumaConfig` changes which Huma owner governs the pool.

instructions.name: set_instant_withdrawal_fee_configs
docs: Sets the instant withdrawal fee configurations.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `fee_configs` - The fee configurations. Each config specifies a liquid asset ratio
threshold and fee in basis points. There can be at most `MAX_INSTANT_WITHDRAWAL_FEE_CONFIGS`
configs.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: set_instant_withdrawal_liquidity_source
docs: Sets the deployment target from which liquidity will be pulled when the pool's available
balance is insufficient to satisfy an instant withdrawal.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

instructions.name: set_instant_withdrawal_reserve_limit
docs: Sets the instant withdrawal reserve limit.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `new_reserve_limit` - The new instant withdrawal reserve limit.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: set_liquid_assets_deployed
docs: Sets the amount of liquid assets, used for instant withdrawal fee tier selection.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `liquid_assets_deployed` - The liquid assets deployed amount in underlying token units.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

instructions.name: set_loss_authority
docs: Sets the loss authority address.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `new_loss_authority` - The address of the new loss authority.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: set_lp_config
docs: Sets Liquidity Provider configurations.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `configs` - The new configurations.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: set_manual_deployment_limits
docs: Sets the limits for manual deployment of liquidity.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `daily_limit` - The maximum cumulative amount that can be deployed manually in a day.
* `per_wallet_limit` - The maximum net amount (deployed minus paid back) that can be outstanding for a single wallet.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner or the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: set_pool_owner_treasury
docs: Sets the pool owner treasury.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `new_treasury` - The address of the new pool owner treasury.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: setup_deployment_target
docs: Performs one-time per-target setup for a deployment target, e.g. initializing required
accounts in the external protocol. Strategies without setup needs treat this as a no-op.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `strategy_type` - The strategy type of the target being set up.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: switch_mode
docs: Switches a lender's investment from one mode to another.
# Trigger Condition
Only when both the protocol and pool are on.
# Arguments
* `shares` - The number of shares the lender wants to switch.
* `investment_id` - The ID of the investment.
# Dev Notes
`investment_id` is not used by the program. It's a pass-through argument used by other
systems in the Huma protocol to detect deposit commitment violations.
# Access Control
Only lenders can call this instruction.

instructions.name: update_mode_apy
docs: Updates mode APY. Both the target and periodic APYs will be updated.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `new_target_apy_bps` - The target annual percentage yield (APY) for the underlying assets
deposited, expressed in basis points.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: update_mode_name
docs: Updates mode name.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `new_name` - The new name of the mode.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: update_mode_token_metadata
docs: Updates mode token metadata.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `args` - The parameters in the token metadata.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

accounts.name: mpl_token_metadata_program
docs: The MPL Token Metadata program.

instructions.name: update_pool_name
docs: Updates pool name.
# Trigger Condition
When the pool is not closed.
# Arguments
* `new_name` - The new name of the pool.
# Access Control
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

instructions.name: withdraw_after_pool_closure
docs: Withdraws all the lender's assets after the pool has been permanently closed.
# Trigger Condition
Only when the protocol is on and the pool is closed.
# Access Control
Only lenders can call this instruction.

instructions.name: withdraw_liquidity_after_target_closure
docs: Exits an async deployment whose target has been closed. Used as the terminal exit
path when the regular `initiate_liquidity_payback_async` /
`complete_liquidity_payback_async` lifecycle is no longer callable because the
underlying target is closed. Burns/redeems the entire remaining position in a
single call.
# Trigger Condition
When the protocol is on, and the (permissionless) pool is not closed. The
underlying async deployment target must itself be closed; that's enforced by the
target's own program when the CPI runs.
# Arguments
* `strategy_type` - The async deployment strategy type.
# Access Control
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

accounts.name: pool_authority
docs: deserialize.

types.name: AsyncDeploymentTargetRemovedEvent

types.name: DeploymentTargetAddedEvent

# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `strategy_type` - The strategy type that was added.
* `target_key` - The target account key for the strategy.

types.name: DeploymentTargetRemovedEvent
docs: A deployment target has been removed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `strategy_type` - The strategy type that was removed.

types.name: DeploymentTargetSetupEvent

* `strategy_type` - The strategy type the target uses.

types.name: HumaConfigChangedEvent

# Fields

* `old_huma_config` - The address of the old Huma config.

* `instant_withdrawal_fee_configs` - The fee configurations for instant withdrawal.
* `liquidity_source` - The `DeploymentConfig` account key identifying the deployment target

types.name: InstantWithdrawalFeeConfig
docs: Instant withdrawal fee configuration (on-chain storage).
# Fields
* `liquid_asset_ratio_lt_bps` - The liquid asset ratio below which the fee is applied.
* `fee_bps` - The fee in basis points.

types.name: InstantWithdrawalFeeConfigInput
docs: Instant withdrawal fee configuration (instruction input, no reserved padding).

types.name: InstantWithdrawalFeeConfigsChangedEvent
docs: The instant withdrawal fee configs have been updated.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `fee_configs` - The new fee configurations.

types.name: InstantWithdrawalLenderAddedEvent
docs: A new instant withdrawal lender has been added.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `lender` - The address of the new instant withdrawal lender being added.

types.name: InstantWithdrawalLenderRemovedEvent
docs: An instant withdrawal lender has been removed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `lender` - The address of the instant withdrawal lender being removed.

types.name: InstantWithdrawalLiquiditySourceClearedEvent
docs: The strategy manager has cleared the liquidity source for instant withdrawals.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet address.
* `old_liquidity_source` - The previous `DeploymentConfig` key.

types.name: InstantWithdrawalLiquiditySourceSetEvent
docs: The strategy manager has set the liquidity source for instant withdrawals.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet address.
* `old_liquidity_source` - The previous `DeploymentConfig` key.
* `new_liquidity_source` - The new `DeploymentConfig` key.

types.name: InstantWithdrawalReserveLimitChangedEvent
docs: The instant withdrawal reserve has been updated.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `old_reserve_limit` - The old instant withdrawal reserve limit.
* `new_reserve_limit` - The new instant withdrawal reserve limit.

types.name: LPConfig
docs: Lender related configurations.
# Fields
* `liquidity_cap` - The max liquidity allowed for the pool.
* `min_deposit_amount` - The minimum amount a lender needs to supply each time they deposit.
* `min_redemption_shares` - The minimum number of shares a lender has to request for redemption,
unless their total number of shares is lower than this value.
* `max_total_redemption_shares_per_window` - The maximum number of shares that can be requested
for redemption across all lenders per time window. No more redemption requests can be
submitted after this limit has been reached in a given window. If this value is set to 0, then
redemption request submission is paused.

types.name: LPConfigChangedEvent
docs: The LP config has been updated.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `lp_config` - The new LP config.

types.name: LenderAccountsClosedEvent
docs: Lender accounts have been permanently closed.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode mint key.
* `payer` - The account that receives the rent-exempt fee refund.
* `lender` - The lender who closed their accounts.

types.name: LenderAccountsCreatedEventV2
docs: Lender accounts have been created.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `payer` - The payer who created the lender accounts and paid for the account rent-exempt fees.
* `lender` - The lender who created their accounts.

types.name: LenderFundDisbursedEvent
docs: A lender's funds from processed redemption requests have been disbursed.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `lender` - The lender whose funds have been disbursed.
* `amount_disbursed` - The amount of the disbursement.

types.name: LenderFundWithdrawnEvent
docs: A lender has withdrawn all their assets after pool closure.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config of the mode from which the lender has withdrawn.
* `lender` - The lender who has withdrawn.
* `shares` - The number of shares burned.
* `assets` - The amount that was withdrawn.

types.name: LenderFundsInstantlyWithdrawnEvent
docs: A lender has withdrawn their assets instantly.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config of the mode from which the withdrawal was made.
* `lender` - The lender who withdrew their assets.
* `shares` - The number of shares burned.
* `assets` - The total amount of assets redeemed (before fee).
* `fee` - The amount of fee in underlying assets sent to pool owner treasury.
* `strategy_liquidity_withdrawn` - The amount of liquidity withdrawn from the strategy.

types.name: LenderRedemptionRecord
docs: The information related to a lender's redemption.
# Fields
* `num_pending_redemption_requests` - The number of pending redemption requests. Note that this
value is only decremented when the redemption request account is closed in `process_redemption_request`,
not in `cancel_redemption_request`.
* `total_amount_processed` - The total amount processed for redemption.
* `total_amount_withdrawn` - The total amount withdrawn by the lender. The withdrawable amount
= `total_amount_processed` - `total_amount_withdrawn`. Since we'll first try to transfer the
processed funds directly to the lender, the withdrawable amount is usually 0. It's only
non-zero if the transfer fails and the funds are kept in the disbursement reserve for the
lender to claim later.
* `shares_pending_redemption` - The number of shares pending redemption.

types.name: LiquidAssetsDeployedSetEvent
docs: The strategist has set the amount of liquid assets deployed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet address.
* `liquid_assets_deployed` - The new liquid assets deployed amount in underlying token units.

types.name: LiquidityDeployedAsyncEvent
docs: The strategy manager has deployed liquidity via an async strategy.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet that initiated the deposit.
* `strategy_type` - The async strategy type used for deployment.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
* `amount` - The amount of underlying tokens deposited.

types.name: LiquidityDeployedEvent
docs: The strategy manager has deployed liquidity from the pool.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet that initiated the liquidity deployment.
* `strategy_type` - The strategy type used for liquidity deployment.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
* `amount` - The amount deployed.

types.name: LiquidityDeployedManuallyEvent
docs: The manual strategy manager has deployed liquidity from the pool.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The manual strategy manager wallet that initiated the deployment.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
* `amount` - The amount deployed.

types.name: LiquidityDepositedEvent
docs: A deposit has been made to the mode.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `depositor` - The account that made the deposit.
* `assets` - The amount of underlying assets deposited.
* `shares` - The number of shares minted for this deposit.
* `commitment` - The commitment type of the deposit.
* `commitment_auto_renewal` - Whether the commitment renews automatically after expiration.

types.name: LiquidityPaidBackEvent
docs: The strategy manager has paid back liquidity to the pool.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet address.
* `amount` - The amount paid back.
* `strategy_type` - The strategy type used for liquidity deployment.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
* `losses_recovered` - The amount of losses recovered in each mode.

types.name: LiquidityPaidBackManuallyEvent
docs: The manual strategy manager has paid back liquidity to the pool.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The manual strategy manager wallet address.
* `amount` - The amount paid back.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.

types.name: LiquidityPaybackCompletedAsyncEvent
docs: The strategy manager has completed a previously initiated payback via an async strategy.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet that completed the payback.
* `strategy_type` - The async strategy type used for the payback.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
* `amount` - The amount of underlying tokens disbursed back to the pool.

types.name: LiquidityPaybackInitiatedAsyncEvent
docs: The strategy manager has initiated a payback via an async strategy.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet that initiated the payback.
* `strategy_type` - The async strategy type used for the payback.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
* `shares` - The number of shares submitted for redemption.

types.name: LiquidityWithdrawnAfterTargetClosureEvent
docs: The strategy manager has fully exited an async deployment whose target has been closed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The strategy manager wallet that executed the exit.
* `strategy_type` - The async strategy type used for the deployment.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
* `amount` - The amount of underlying tokens returned to the pool.

types.name: LossAuthorityChangedEvent
docs: The loss authority has been changed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `old_loss_authority` - The address of the old loss authority.
* `new_loss_authority` - The address of the new loss authority.

types.name: LossDeclaredEvent
docs: The loss authority has declared loss on the investment.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `loss_authority` - The loss authority address.
* `loss_distributed` - The loss distributed to each mode.

types.name: LossRecoveredEvent
docs: The loss authority has recovered loss by transferring assets to the pool.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `loss_authority` - The loss authority address.
* `amount` - The amount transferred to the pool for loss recovery.
* `losses_recovered` - The amount of losses recovered in each mode.

types.name: ManageModeTokenMetadataArgs
docs: Parameters used for creating and updating mode token metadata. All string lengths
are checked by the MPL token metadata program, hence omitted here.
# Fields
* `name` - The name of the mode token.
* `symbol` - The symbol of the mode token.
* `uri` - The URI of additional mode token metadata stored off-chain.

types.name: ManualDeploymentLimitChangedEvent
docs: The manual deploy limits have been changed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `daily_limit` - The maximum cumulative amount that can be deployed manually in a day.
* `per_wallet_limit` - The maximum net amount (deployed minus paid back) that can be outstanding for a single wallet.

types.name: ManualStrategyManager
docs: An approved manual strategy manager that can deploy and pay back liquidity via the
Manual strategy. Each manual strategy manager can only deploy into its own wallet.
# Fields
* `bump` - The bump of the account.
* `wallet` - The authorized wallet address.

types.name: ManualStrategyManagerApprovedEvent
docs: A manual strategy manager has been approved by the protocol owner.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The approved wallet address.

types.name: ManualStrategyManagerProposal
docs: A pending proposal to add a manual strategy manager. Created by the pool owner
and must be approved by the Huma owner.
# Fields
* `bump` - The bump of the account.
* `pool_config` - The `PoolConfig` key this proposal belongs to.
* `wallet` - The proposed wallet address for the manual strategy manager.
* `proposed_at` - The Unix timestamp at which the proposal was created.

types.name: ManualStrategyManagerProposalCancelledEvent
docs: A manual strategy manager proposal has been cancelled.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The wallet address of the cancelled proposal.

types.name: ManualStrategyManagerProposedEvent
docs: A manual strategy manager has been proposed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The proposed wallet address.

types.name: ManualStrategyManagerRemovedEvent
docs: A manual strategy manager has been removed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The wallet address that was removed.

types.name: ModeAPYChangedEvent
docs: The mode APY has been updated.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `target_apy_bps` - The new target APY expressed in basis points.
* `periodic_apy_bps` - The new periodic APY expressed in basis points.

types.name: ModeAddedEvent
docs: A mode has been added to the pool.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `mode_id` - The mode ID.
* `mode_name` - The name of the mode.
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `mode_mint` - The mode token mint key.
* `mode_token` - The mode token account key.
* `mode_token_name` - The name of the mode token.
* `mode_token_symbol` - The symbol of the mode token.
* `mode_token_uri` - The URI of additional mode token metadata stored off-chain.

types.name: ModeAssetsRefreshedEvent
docs: The assets for a mode have been refreshed.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `old_assets` - The mode assets before update.
* `new_assets` - The updated mode assets.

types.name: ModeConfig
docs: The configurations of a mode.
# Fields
* `bump` - The bump of the mode.
* `mint_bump` - The bump of the mode mint.
* `id` - The ID of the mode.
* `name` - The name of the mode.
* `target_apy_bps` - The target annual percentage yield (APY) for the underlying assets
deposited, expressed in basis points.
* `periodic_apy_bps` - The periodic rate, expressed as an APY in basis points. When compounded
over the chosen periods in a year (e.g., every second), this rate yields the same
overall annual return as target_apy_bps.

types.name: ModeNameChangedEvent
docs: The mode name has been updated.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `name` - The new name of the mode.

types.name: ModeRemovedEvent
docs: A mode has been removed from the pool.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `mode_id` - The mode ID.

types.name: ModeState
docs: The states of a mode.
# Fields
* `assets` - The total amount of underlying assets in th mode. This includes both principals
and yields (realized and unrealized).
* `losses` - The total outstanding losses in the mode.
* `cumulative_yields` - The cumulative amount of yields accrued in this mode.
* `assets_refreshed_at` - The last timestamp at which `assets` was refreshed.

types.name: ModeSwitchedEvent
docs: A lender has switched their investment from one mode to another.
# Fields
* `source_mode_config` - The source mode config key.
* `destination_mode_config` - The destination mode config key.
* `lender` - The lender who switched mode.
* `source_shares_burned` - The number of shares burned in the source mode.
* `destination_shares_burned` - The number of shares minted in the destination mode.
* `assets_switched` - The amount switched mode.
* `investment_id` - The ID of the original investment.

types.name: ModeTokenMetadataUpdatedEvent
docs: The token metadata has been updated for a mode.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `name` - The name of the mode token.
* `symbol` - The symbol of the mode token.
* `uri` - The URI of additional mode token metadata stored off-chain.

types.name: PoolClosedEvent
docs: The pool has been closed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.

types.name: PoolCreatedEvent
docs: A permissionless pool has been created.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `huma_config` - The ID of the Huma config that the pool is associated with.
* `pool_owner` - The address of the pool owner.
* `pool_owner_treasury` - The address of the pool owner treasury.
* `underlying_mint` - The mint account of the underlying asset.
* `pool_underlying_token` - The underlying asset token account of the pool.
* `pool_authority` - The address of the pool authority account.
* `pool_name` - The name of the pool.

types.name: PoolDisabledEvent
docs: The pool has been disabled.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.

types.name: PoolEnabledEvent
docs: The pool has been enabled.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.

types.name: PoolEnteredPreClosureEvent
docs: The pool has entered the pre-closure status to prepare for final closing.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.

types.name: PoolNameChangedEvent
docs: The pool name has been updated.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `pool_name` - The new name of the pool.

types.name: PoolOperatorAddedEvent
docs: A new pool operator has been added.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `operator` - The address of the new operator being added.

types.name: PoolOperatorRemovedEvent
docs: A pool operator has been removed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `operator` - The address of the operator being removed.

types.name: PoolOwnerChangedEvent
docs: The pool owner has changed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `owner` - The address of the new owner.

types.name: PoolOwnerTreasuryChangedEvent
docs: The pool owner treasury has been updated.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `old_treasury` - The address of the old pool owner treasury.
* `new_treasury` - The address of the new pool owner treasury.

types.name: PoolState
docs: The state of a pool.
# Fields
* `status` - The current lifecycle status of the pool (Off, On, PreClosure, Closed).
* `disbursement_reserve` - The total amount of underlying assets reserved for pending
disbursements to lenders who were not able to receive their funds when their redemption
request was processed.
* `mode_states` - Per-mode states, ordered to match `mode_config_keys`.
* `mode_config_keys` - The public keys of the mode configs registered in this pool.
* `redemption_queue` - Tracks queued redemption requests and gating state.
* `pool_stats` - Cumulative deployment and pay-back statistics.
* `liquid_assets_deployed` - The amount of assets deployed to other liquid DeFi protocols, used for
instant withdrawal fee computation. Program instructions automatically increase this
value on deployment and decrease this value when liquidity is withdrawn from the strategy;
the strategy manager can also set it directly via `set_liquid_assets_deployed`.

types.name: PoolStatus
docs: The pool status
# Variants
* `Off` - The pool is temporarily turned off.
* `On` - The pool is active.
* `PreClosure` - The pool is undergoing final processing to prepare for closure.
* `Closed` - The pool is closed after maturity.

types.name: PrivilegedInstantWithdrawalEvent
docs: An instant withdrawal lender has withdrawn their assets instantly.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config of the mode from which the withdrawal was made.
* `lender` - The instant withdrawal lender who withdrew their own shares.
* `shares` - The number of shares burned.
* `assets` - The amount of assets withdrawn.
* `strategy_liquidity_needed` - The amount of liquidity withdrawn from the strategy.

types.name: RedeemedFundsPaidOutEvent
docs: Redeemed funds have been paid out to the lender.
# Fields
* `request_id` - The ID of the redemption request that was processed.
* `lender` - The lender whose shares have been redeemed.
* `amount` - The amount of the disbursement.

types.name: RedeemedFundsReservedEvent
docs: Redeemed funds have been held in the protocol for manual claiming later.
# Fields
* `request_id` - The ID of the redemption request that was processed.
* `lender` - The lender whose shares have been redeemed.
* `amount` - The amount that was reserved.

types.name: Redemption
docs: States for the global redemption queue.
# Fields
* `next_request_id` - The ID of the next redemption request to be processed.
* `last_request_id` - The ID of the last unprocessed redemption request in the queue.
* `redemption_gating` - Redemption gating information tracker.

types.name: RedemptionGating
docs: Redemption gating information tracker.
# Fields
* `total_shares_requested` - The total number of shares requested for redemption during
the current window. No redemption request can be submitted once the total shares requested
reaches the limit defined in `LPConfig`.
* `window_starts_at` - The Unix timestamp (UTC) marking the start of the current 24-hour
redemption window.

types.name: RedemptionRequest
docs: States for a lender's redemption request.
#  Fields
* `bump` - The bump of the account.
* `id` - The ID of the redemption request.
* `lender` - The lender who submitted the request.
* `mode_config` - The `ModeConfig` key of the mode that the request was added to.
* `shares_requested` - The number of shares requested for redemption.
* `requested_at` - The timestamp at which the request was submitted.

types.name: RedemptionRequestAddedEventV2
docs: A redemption request has been added.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `payer` - The payer who paid for the rent-exempt fees of the new `RedemptionRequest` account.
* `lender` - The lender who requested redemption.
* `request_id` - The ID of the newly created request.
* `shares` - The number of shares to be redeemed.

types.name: RedemptionRequestCanceledEvent
docs: A lender has reduced the number of shares requested for redemption.
# Fields
* `mode_config` - The mode config key.
* `lender` - The lender who requested redemption.
* `request_id` - The ID of the newly created request.
* `shares` - The number of shares to be redeemed.

types.name: RedemptionRequestProcessedEvent
docs: A redemption request has been processed.
# Fields
* `request_id` - The ID of the redemption request.
* `lender` - The lender who submitted the request.
* `shares_processed` - The number of shares processed.
* `amount_processed` - The resulting amount processed.

types.name: StrategyManagerWalletAddedEvent
docs: A wallet has been added for the strategy manager.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The wallet address.

types.name: StrategyManagerWalletRemovedEvent
docs: A wallet for the strategy manager has been removed.
# Fields
* `pool_id` - The pool ID.
* `wallet` - The wallet address.
